text:
alex.k: Heads-up — planning a staged enable for model `zephyr-mini` on Dedicated tomorrow 10:00 PDT. Goal: low-risk warmup that lets us rapidly pin back if we see regressions.

maya: +1. Brief plan: per-region warmup -> 15m at 5% traffic, 30m QA window, then slow ramp to 20% for 1h, then full flip if green.

liam: For fallback ordering I propose: 1) zephyr-alt-quant (closest perf/quality), 2) legacy-small, 3) emergency-fallback (degen). Want this as an ordered fallback, not round-robin.

alex.k: Agree on order. Also want a rapid-pin signal that bypasses normal rollout windows — operator command that forcibly pins traffic to `zephyr-stable` across both regions.

deploybot: deploybot here — preflight started for `zephyr-mini` enable. Checks: infra health ✅, model checksum ✅, telemetry hooks registered ✅. Suggested emergency-pin trigger: p95 latency >= +15% vs baseline OR error-rate >= 1% over 5m.

opsbot: opsbot: note on priming — first-token cost and cold-KV hits are expected. Please run a KV priming job during the 15m warmup:```sh
curl -X POST https://internal-cache/prime -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"zephyr-mini","seed_prompts":10}'
```This drops the initial latency spike.

jen: Add to release notes: change window 10:00-12:00 PDT, expected customer impact none, rollback owner = @sam, contact #customer-uptime if p95 jumps >50ms. I'll draft the note and ping legal for any compliance flags.

sam: I'll own the emergency-pin. Runbook excerpt I'll follow: 1) set pin via `platformctl pin --model=zephyr-stable --scope=all` 2) revoke traffic weights, 3) notify sales + success. If deploybot auto-suggests pin, I will ACK within 2m.

liam: One more: during warmup, use lighter KV cache TTLs (30s) so we can observe steady-state behavior quickly. After 1h at 20% revert TTLs to normal.

alex.k: Perfect. Final ask: can QA team run the crash-cases set and perf harness at 09:30? maya, can you coordinate? :eyes:

maya: Yep — QA scheduled 09:30-09:50, will paste results in this thread.

deploybot: preflight checklist complete. Standing by for manual approval at 10:00. Command to start: `/deploy start --model=zephyr-mini --mode=staged --regions=us-west1,eu-west1`

alex.k: Approved. All signoffs recorded. If anyone wants different fallback ordering speak now, otherwise we proceed with the plan. :thumbsup:
